stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Sue is Reed's former girlfriend, now working for Victor von Doom, when she joins his space mission. After the cosmic storm they fall for each other again, and Reed proposes to her.
stages.whoA: His ex-girlfriend Sue. They rekindle their love, and he proposes.
stages.whoB: Her ex, Reed. They fall back in love, and he proposes.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Reed and Sue keep trying to hold their wedding while the Silver Surfer threatens Earth. Once Galactus is stopped, they finally marry in Japan.
stages.whoA: His fiancée, then his wife, after a wedding that keeps getting interrupted.
stages.whoB: Her fiancé, then her husband, once they finally marry in Japan.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Sue and Johnny are sister and brother. She keeps trying to rein in her reckless younger brother, and together they wrap Doom in fire to beat him.
stages.whoA: Her reckless younger brother, and her teammate in the Fantastic Four.
stages.whoB: His older sister, who keeps trying to rein him in.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Ben is Reed's oldest friend and joins him on Doom's station. When the storm turns Ben to stone, Reed vows to cure him, and Ben chooses to stay the Thing to save Reed from Doom.
stages.whoA: His best friend, who chooses to stay the Thing to save him.
stages.whoB: His best friend, who vows to find him a cure.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Johnny joins Reed's mission as Sue's brother and gains fire powers. He clashes with Reed over hiding their powers, but fights beside him as the Fantastic Four.
stages.whoA: Sue's hotheaded brother, and his teammate in the Fantastic Four.
stages.whoB: His sister's ex, and the cautious leader of their team.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Reed studies the power swapping Johnny is left with after his clash with the Surfer. When Reed marries Sue, Johnny becomes his brother in law.
stages.whoA: His teammate, and his brother in law once he marries Sue.
stages.whoB: His teammate, and his brother in law once Reed marries Sue.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Ben and Johnny are changed by the same storm and become teammates. Johnny teases Ben about his rocky body, and the two trade jokes and pranks.
stages.whoA: His teammate, a showoff who never stops teasing him.
stages.whoB: His rocky teammate, his favorite target for jokes.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Sue and Ben share the cosmic storm and become teammates. She stands by him after his change and fights beside him against Doom.
stages.whoA: Her teammate and friend, turned to stone by the storm.
stages.whoB: His teammate and friend, Reed's great love.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Alicia, a blind sculptor, meets Ben in a bar after his change and sees past his rocky skin. They fall in love, and she helps him accept being the Thing.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend, a blind sculptor who sees who he really is.
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend, who learns to accept himself through her.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Alicia stays with Ben as his girlfriend and attends Reed and Sue's wedding at his side.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend, at his side for Reed and Sue's wedding.
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend, whom she joins at Reed and Sue's wedding.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Debbie is Ben's fiancée when he leaves for Doom's station. When she sees what he has become, she sets her engagement ring down in front of him and walks away.
stages.whoA: His fiancée, who leaves him after his change.
stages.whoB: Her fiancé, whom she leaves once he becomes the Thing.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Victor is Reed's old rival, now a rich businessman who funds Reed's space mission. He resents Reed and blames him when the mission fails.
stages.whoA: His old rival, whose failed mission he funds and blames.
stages.whoB: His old rival, who funds his space mission.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: As his body turns to metal, Doom drives a wedge between Reed and Ben, then captures Reed and tortures him. The Fantastic Four defeat him and freeze him solid.
stages.whoA: His enemy, whom he tortures, and whose team freezes him.
stages.whoB: Doom, who captures and tortures him.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Freed by the Surfer's energy, Doom is brought in by the military to work with Reed. He betrays them, steals the Surfer's board and fights the team in Shanghai.
stages.whoA: Forced to work with him again, until he steals the board.
stages.whoB: Forced on him by the military, until Doom betrays them all.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Sue is Victor's head of genetics research, and he hopes to marry her. He brings her along on Reed's space mission.
stages.whoA: His head of genetics research, whom he hopes to marry.
stages.whoB: Her boss, who wants to marry her.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: When Sue chooses Reed, the changed Doom turns on the team. She fights him to free Reed, and with Johnny she wraps him in fire to bring him down.
stages.whoA: Once the woman he wanted, now his enemy.
stages.whoB: Her former boss, now Doom, the enemy she helps freeze.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Back from the ice, Doom steals the Surfer's board. In Shanghai he impales Sue, and she dies in the fight until the Surfer brings her back.
stages.whoA: His enemy, whom he kills in Shanghai.
stages.whoB: Doom, who kills her in Shanghai.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Doom drives a wedge between Ben and Reed, then powers Reed's machine to turn Ben human again, which makes Doom stronger. He knocks the human Ben out, and Ben becomes the Thing again to stop him.
stages.whoA: His enemy, turned human and knocked out during his plot.
stages.whoB: Doom, who turns him against Reed and knocks him out.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Freed from the ice, Doom steals the Surfer's board. In Shanghai Ben helps Johnny beat him and take the board back.
stages.whoA: The Thing, who helps beat him in Shanghai.
stages.whoB: Doom, whom he helps beat in Shanghai.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Doom fires a heat seeking missile at Johnny, who escapes it by lighting a garbage barge. Johnny then helps the team freeze Doom.
stages.whoA: His enemy, who outflies his heat seeking missile.
stages.whoB: Doom, who fires a heat seeking missile at him.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Johnny takes on the powers of the whole team and battles Doom in Shanghai. With Ben's help he beats him and takes back the Surfer's board.
stages.whoA: The Torch, who beats him with the whole team's powers.
stages.whoB: Doom, whom he beats using all four of their powers.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: The Surfer's passing frees Doom from his frozen state. Doom confronts him, later helps the military capture him, and steals his board and its power.
stages.whoA: The Surfer, whose board and power he steals.
stages.whoB: Doom, who steals his board and its power.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Doom offers the military what he knows about the Silver Surfer, and General Hager forces the team to work with him. Doom only wants the Surfer's board, and once he has it he kills Hager.
stages.whoA: The general who takes him on, and whom he kills.
stages.whoB: The man he brings in against the Surfer, who kills him.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: General Hager calls on Reed to track the Silver Surfer. The two clash at every turn, and Hager forces the team to work with Doom.
stages.whoA: The scientist he needs, and dislikes, for the Surfer hunt.
stages.whoB: The general who pushes him around and forces Doom on him.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Captain Frankie Raye serves on General Hager's team and carries out his orders in the hunt for the Silver Surfer.
stages.whoA: A captain on his team in the hunt for the Surfer.
stages.whoB: Her commanding general in the hunt for the Surfer.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: After the Surfer is cut off from his board, Hager's military holds him in a cell in Siberia and tortures him.
stages.whoA: The alien his military captures and tortures.
stages.whoB: The general who imprisons and tortures him.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Johnny falls for Captain Raye while she works with the team, and she keeps brushing him off. She later lets the team go so they can chase Doom.
stages.whoA: The captain he falls for, who keeps him at arm's length.
stages.whoB: The Torch, who keeps flirting with her.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Johnny chases the Surfer across New York and is overpowered, and the contact leaves him swapping powers with anyone he touches.
stages.whoA: The alien who overpowers him and scrambles his powers.
stages.whoB: The Torch, who chases him and loses.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: When the Surfer turns on Galactus, Johnny helps him fly up to face it.
stages.whoA: The Surfer, whom he helps fly up to face Galactus.
stages.whoB: The Torch, who helps him reach Galactus.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Sue reaches the Surfer, who tells her he is not the one destroying Earth. She dies shielding him from Doom, and he brings her back to life.
stages.whoA: The alien she befriends, who brings her back to life.
stages.whoB: The woman who reaches him, and whom he revives.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Reed tracks the Surfer for the military and builds the pulse that cuts him off from his board.
stages.whoA: The alien he hunts and cuts off from his board.
stages.whoB: The scientist who separates him from his board.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: After Doom steals the board, Reed and the team free the Surfer, and he gives his life to stop Galactus.
stages.whoA: The alien he frees, who saves Earth from Galactus.
stages.whoB: The leader of the team that frees him.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: The Surfer is Galactus's herald, finding worlds for him to devour so that his own world is spared.
stages.whoA: His master, a cloud that devours worlds.
stages.whoB: His herald, who leads him to worlds to devour.

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Moved by Sue, the Surfer turns on Galactus and flies into him, destroying him in a blinding blast.
stages.whoA: His former master, whom he destroys to save Earth.
stages.whoB: His herald, who turns on him and destroys him.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Whistler took Blade in as a boy and taught him to fight vampires. He makes Blade's weapons and the serum that holds back his thirst. When Frost's vampires bite Whistler, Blade helps him end his life.
stages.whoA: His mentor, who took him in and arms him.
stages.whoB: The half vampire he raised and trained.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Blade finds Whistler alive as a vampire and cures him. Whistler fights beside him again against the Reapers.
stages.whoA: His mentor, rescued from the vampires and cured.
stages.whoB: The hunter who rescues him and cures him.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Whistler dies when the FBI raids his base, and Blade surrenders soon after.
stages.whoA: His mentor, killed in the FBI raid.
stages.whoB: The hunter he raised, left alone when he dies.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Blade saves Karen after she is bitten and takes her to Whistler. She finds a cure, frees him at the temple by letting him drink her blood, and stays to make him a better serum.
stages.whoA: The doctor he saves, who saves him back with her blood.
stages.whoB: The hunter who saves her and lets her help.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Whistler treats Karen after her bite and warns her to leave the city. She stays and works in his lab on a cure.
stages.whoA: The doctor he treats, who stays to work in his lab.
stages.whoB: Blade's mentor, who treats her bite.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Frost is the vampire who bit Blade's mother while she carried him. He wants Blade's blood to become La Magra, and Blade kills him with anticoagulant darts.
stages.whoA: The vampire who bit his mother, and his sworn enemy.
stages.whoB: The Daywalker whose blood he needs for La Magra.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Blade burns and maims Quinn more than once before finally killing him at the Temple of Eternal Night.
stages.whoA: Frost's lieutenant, whom he keeps maiming and finally kills.
stages.whoB: The hunter who keeps maiming him, then kills him.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Mercury helps Frost hunt Blade, and Blade kills her at the Temple of Eternal Night.
stages.whoA: Frost's lover, whom he kills at the temple.
stages.whoB: The hunter she helps Frost catch.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Blade tortures the archivist Pearl with a UV light until he gives up Frost's plan to raise La Magra.
stages.whoA: The archivist he tortures for Frost's plan.
stages.whoB: The hunter who tortures him with UV light.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Blade stops Krieger from attacking Karen, then tracks him down and beats him until he talks about Frost.
stages.whoA: A vampires' cop he beats for information.
stages.whoB: The hunter who beats Frost's secrets out of him.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: When Blade raids the blood rave Racquel has led a man into, she comes after him, and he blasts her to ash.
stages.whoA: A vampire at the blood rave, blasted to ash.
stages.whoB: The hunter who wrecks the rave and kills her.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Quinn is Frost's mocking lieutenant and carries out his plans, even after Blade maims him.
stages.whoA: His mocking lieutenant.
stages.whoB: His master, Deacon Frost.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Mercury is Frost's lover and enforcer, helping him hunt Blade and raise La Magra.
stages.whoA: His lover and enforcer.
stages.whoB: Her lover, whose rise to La Magra she serves.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Dragonetti, a pureblood elder, scolds Frost for his recklessness and reminds him of his place. Frost has him stripped of his fangs and left to burn in the sunrise.
stages.whoA: The elder who scorns him, and whom he burns alive.
stages.whoB: The upstart he scorns, who leaves him to burn.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Krieger is a familiar who serves Frost. After Blade makes him talk, Frost kills him for failing.
stages.whoA: A human servant he kills for failing.
stages.whoB: The vampire he serves, who kills him.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Frost's vampires attack Whistler's hideout and carry Karen off as bait for Blade. She escapes the pit Frost throws her into and gives Blade her blood so he can fight back.
stages.whoA: The doctor he kidnaps to lure Blade.
stages.whoB: The vampire who kidnaps her to trap Blade.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Frost and his vampires raid Whistler's hideout and bite him, leaving him to turn.
stages.whoA: Blade's mentor, bitten when he raids the hideout.
stages.whoB: The vampire whose crew bites him.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Badly burned and taken to the hospital, Quinn feeds on Karen and escapes, leaving her marked.
stages.whoA: The doctor he bites at the hospital.
stages.whoB: The vampire who bites her.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Quinn and Mercury both serve Frost and work together to hunt Blade and raise La Magra.
stages.whoA: His fellow servant of Frost.
stages.whoB: Her fellow servant of Frost.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Mercury seizes Dragonetti and brings him to the shore, where Frost leaves him to burn.
stages.whoA: The elder she seizes for Frost.
stages.whoB: Frost's lover, who drags him to his death.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Krieger, a cop serving the vampires, attacks Karen in her apartment before Blade steps in.
stages.whoA: The vampires' cop who attacks her at home.
stages.whoB: The marked doctor he attacks.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Scud is the young weapons maker who arms Blade while Whistler is missing.
stages.whoA: His young weapons maker.
stages.whoB: The hunter he arms.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Scud reveals he has been spying for Damaskinos all along. Blade, who knew it, blows him up with his own bomb.
stages.whoA: A spy for Damaskinos, killed with his own bomb.
stages.whoB: The hunter he betrays, who saw it coming.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Whistler comes back to find Scud making Blade's weapons in his place. They work side by side until Scud is unmasked as Damaskinos's spy.
stages.whoA: Blade's new weapons maker, unmasked as a spy.
stages.whoB: Blade's old mentor, back to work beside him.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Scud is secretly a familiar of Damaskinos, spying on Blade for him.
stages.whoA: His vampire master.
stages.whoB: His spy inside Blade's base.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Nyssa recruits Blade to hunt the Reapers and comes to trust him, and feelings grow between them. Bitten by Nomak, she asks Blade to take her into the sunrise and dies in his arms.
stages.whoA: The vampire who hunts at his side and dies in his arms.
stages.whoB: The Daywalker she comes to trust and care for.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: The Bloodpack trained for years to kill Blade, but Damaskinos puts him in command of them to hunt the Reapers. One by one they fall.
stages.whoA: The vampire team built to kill him, now under his command.
stages.whoB: Their target, now their commander against the Reapers.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Reinhardt despises Blade, who plants a bomb on his head to keep him in line. Reinhardt betrays him to Damaskinos, and Blade slices him in half.
stages.whoA: The Bloodpack brute he keeps leashed with a bomb.
stages.whoB: The Daywalker he hates and betrays.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Damaskinos calls a truce with Blade to stop the Reapers, hiding that he made them. He then captures Blade to drain his blood.
stages.whoA: The vampire overlord who uses him and betrays him.
stages.whoB: The Daywalker he needs, then captures.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Nomak offers Blade an alliance and is answered with a bullet. Beaten by Blade at last, he drives Blade's sword into his own heart.
stages.whoA: The first Reaper, whom he finally defeats.
stages.whoB: The Daywalker who beats him.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Kounen speaks for Damaskinos at the truce, then has Blade captured and starts draining his blood.
stages.whoA: Damaskinos's lawyer, who has him drained.
stages.whoB: The Daywalker he captures and drains.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Nyssa is Damaskinos's daughter and serves his Vampire Nation, unaware that he made the Reapers.
stages.whoA: Her father, the vampire overlord.
stages.whoB: His daughter.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Nomak is the son Damaskinos experimented on, creating the Reaper strain. Nomak comes home and kills him.
stages.whoA: His father, who made him a Reaper. He kills him.
stages.whoB: His son, whom he turned into the first Reaper.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Nomak is Nyssa's brother, though she learns it only late. After killing their father, he bites her.
stages.whoA: Her brother, the first Reaper, who bites her.
stages.whoB: His sister, whom he bites.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Nyssa works alongside the Bloodpack on the hunt for the Reapers.
stages.whoA: The team she hunts the Reapers with.
stages.whoB: A pureblood who hunts beside them.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Reinhardt is a leading member of the Bloodpack.
stages.whoA: His Bloodpack teammates.
stages.whoB: One of their own.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Reinhardt serves Damaskinos and hands Blade and Whistler over to him.
stages.whoA: The overlord he serves.
stages.whoB: One of his Bloodpack fighters.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Reinhardt resents Blade's mentor, and in the sewers he and Chupa turn on Whistler.
stages.whoA: Blade's mentor, whom he turns on in the sewers.
stages.whoB: The Bloodpack brute who turns on him.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Nomak corners Whistler in the sewers but spares him, telling him the truth about Damaskinos and handing him the family ring.
stages.whoA: The man he spares and tells the truth.
stages.whoB: The Reaper who spares him and tells him who he is.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Nomak's Reapers tear through the Bloodpack in the club and the sewers.
stages.whoA: The vampires his Reapers hunt down.
stages.whoB: The Reaper whose plague kills them.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: The Bloodpack are Damaskinos's shock troops, and he sends them to hunt the Reapers under Blade.
stages.whoA: His shock troops.
stages.whoB: The overlord who commands them.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Kounen is Damaskinos's human familiar and lawyer, the public face of his business.
stages.whoA: His familiar and lawyer.
stages.whoB: His vampire master.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Captured with Blade in Damaskinos's stronghold, Whistler exposes the truth that Damaskinos made the Reapers.
stages.whoA: Blade's mentor, who exposes his secret.
stages.whoB: The overlord whose secret he exposes.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Kounen is draining Blade's blood when Whistler guns him down.
stages.whoA: The man who guns him down.
stages.whoB: Damaskinos's lawyer, whom he shoots.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Abigail is Whistler's daughter, and she hunts vampires as he did. He dies in the FBI raid before Blade joins her.
stages.whoA: Her father, Blade's mentor.
stages.whoB: His daughter, a hunter like him.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Abigail, Whistler's daughter, helps rescue Blade from custody and asks him to join the Nightstalkers. They hunt Drake together.
stages.whoA: Whistler's daughter, who fights beside him.
stages.whoB: Her father's fellow hunter, now fighting beside her.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Hannibal leads Blade's rescue and asks his help against Drake. Blade finds his jokes hard to take but rescues him from the vampires.
stages.whoA: The wisecracking hunter he can barely stand.
stages.whoB: The Daywalker he rescues and tries to win over.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Abigail and Hannibal are fellow Nightstalkers who rescue Blade together. She tends his wounds after Drake beats him, and later frees him from the vampires.
stages.whoA: Her fellow Nightstalker and close friend.
stages.whoB: His fellow Nightstalker and close friend.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Drake is woken to destroy Blade and comes to see him as a worthy foe. Blade stabs him with the Daystar arrow, and as he dies Drake honors him.
stages.whoA: The first vampire, whom he kills with Daystar.
stages.whoB: The Daywalker he respects as a warrior and fights.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Danica frames Blade for killing a human and taunts him in custody. The Daystar virus he releases kills her.
stages.whoA: The vampire who frames him.
stages.whoB: The Daywalker she frames and hunts.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Asher stands with Danica as their vampires hunt Blade.
stages.whoA: Danica's brother, hunting him.
stages.whoB: The Daywalker they hunt.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Chief Vreede holds Blade in custody for the vampires. Later Blade drags him to the blood farm and kills him for rounding up humans.
stages.whoA: The police chief serving vampires, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: The prisoner he hands to vampires, and his killer.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Dr. Vance examines Blade in custody and declares him psychotic so he can be handed to the vampires.
stages.whoA: The psychiatrist who tries to hand him to vampires.
stages.whoB: The prisoner he declares psychotic.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Sommerfield builds the Daystar virus for Blade and the Nightstalkers, and leaves him a recording warning it could kill him too.
stages.whoA: The scientist who builds the Daystar virus.
stages.whoB: The Daywalker who will carry her virus.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: When Drake's vampires take Zoe, Blade storms the Talos building with Abigail to bring her back.
stages.whoA: Sommerfield's daughter, whom he rescues.
stages.whoB: The hunter who rescues her.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Zoe is Sommerfield's young daughter, living with her among the Nightstalkers.
stages.whoA: Her young daughter.
stages.whoB: Her mother.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Hannibal and Zoe are taken together. He refuses to talk even when the vampires threaten to make him feed on her.
stages.whoA: The little girl he protects in captivity.
stages.whoB: The hunter held prisoner with her.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Sommerfield is the Nightstalkers' scientist, working beside Hannibal until Drake raids their hideout.
stages.whoA: The team's scientist.
stages.whoB: Her teammate.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Abigail and Sommerfield are fellow Nightstalkers, and Abigail fires Sommerfield's Daystar arrow.
stages.whoA: The scientist behind her Daystar arrow.
stages.whoB: Her teammate.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Hedges is the weapons maker of Hannibal's Nightstalkers, killed when Drake raids the hideout.
stages.whoA: The team's weapons maker.
stages.whoB: His teammate.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Hedges builds the Nightstalkers' weapons, Abigail's among them, until Drake kills him.
stages.whoA: The team's weapons maker.
stages.whoB: His teammate.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Dex is one of Hannibal's Nightstalkers, killed in the raid on their hideout.
stages.whoA: A fellow Nightstalker.
stages.whoB: His teammate.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Danica turned Hannibal into a vampire and kept him as her servant until the Nightstalkers cured him. She later tortures him, and he watches the virus kill her.
stages.whoA: The vampire who turned him and kept him as her servant.
stages.whoB: Her former servant, now hunting her.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Asher helps Danica torture the captive Hannibal for the Daystar secret.
stages.whoA: Danica's brother, who tortures him.
stages.whoB: The captive hunter he tortures.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Triton is Black Bolt's cousin. Feared dead on Oahu, he returns and captures Maximus for him.
stages.whoA: His cousin, who captures Maximus for him.
stages.whoB: His cousin and king.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Karnak and Triton are brothers in the Royal Family.
stages.whoA: His brother.
stages.whoB: His brother.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Karnak and Gorgon are cousins and old friends who scold each other's extremes. Gorgon rescues Karnak and Jen on Oahu, and when Gorgon dies, Karnak brings him back through a second Terrigenesis and helps him remember.
stages.whoA: His cousin, whom he brings back from death.
stages.whoB: His cousin, who brings him back.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Gorgon is Triton's cousin, and when Triton goes missing on Oahu, Gorgon heads to Earth to find him.
stages.whoA: His cousin, whom he goes to Earth to find.
stages.whoB: His cousin, who comes looking for him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Maximus, Medusa's brother in law, makes advances on her, and during his coup he shaves her head to take away her powers. She later bargains with him for Attilan's safety, but he will not give up the throne.
stages.whoA: Her brother in law, who shaves off her hair.
stages.whoB: His brother's wife, whom he strips of her powers.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Maximus locks up his sister in law Crystal and presses her to back his rule. She pretends to agree, then disowns him before the Genetic Council and escapes to Earth with Lockjaw.
stages.whoA: Her brother in law, whose rule she defies.
stages.whoB: His sister in law, who defies him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Karnak uncovers his cousin Maximus's coup and warns the family. Back on Attilan, Maximus has him locked in the quiet room.
stages.whoA: His cousin, whose coup he uncovers.
stages.whoB: His cousin, who uncovers the coup.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Maximus sends a strike team and then Auran's party to kill his cousin Gorgon on Earth.
stages.whoA: His cousin, who sends killers after him.
stages.whoB: His cousin, whom he wants dead.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Triton kills Maximus's bodyguards, captures his cousin and delivers him to Black Bolt.
stages.whoA: His cousin, whom he captures.
stages.whoB: His cousin, who captures him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Tibor is Maximus's old friend, though Maximus resents that Tibor won a seat on the Genetic Council while he came out of Terrigenesis human. As king, Maximus demands that Tibor prove his loyalty.
stages.whoA: His old friend on the Genetic Council.
stages.whoB: His old friend, now king.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Tibor joins the rebels plotting to overthrow Maximus, who uncovers the plot and kills him.
stages.whoA: His old friend turned plotter, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: His old friend, who kills him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Auran is Maximus's new head of the Royal Guard and hunts the royals on Earth for him. Disillusioned by his true aims, she deserts him for the evacuation.
stages.whoA: His guard captain, who finally deserts him.
stages.whoB: The king she serves, then abandons.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Maximus frees Mordis from prison to help Auran hunt the royal family.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he frees to hunt his family.
stages.whoB: The king who frees him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Locus serves Maximus in Auran's party hunting the royals on Earth.
stages.whoA: One of the guards he sends to Earth.
stages.whoB: The king she serves.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Maximus secretly funds Declan's research into the Inhumans, hoping to use it to go through Terrigenesis again. Declan does not know who his backer really is.
stages.whoA: The scientist he secretly funds.
stages.whoB: His secret backer.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Eldrac, the living doorway in Attilan's walls, sends Maximus's fighters to Earth on his orders.
stages.whoA: The living doorway he commands.
stages.whoB: The king who commands him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Auran tracks Medusa on Oahu and fights her, and Medusa stabs her. Auran heals and keeps hunting the royals.
stages.whoA: The queen who stabs her.
stages.whoB: The guard who hunts her.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Back on Attilan, Auran guarantees Medusa's safety for a last talk with Maximus, and refuses his order to kill her.
stages.whoA: The queen she protects.
stages.whoB: The guard who refuses to kill her.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Auran was once Gorgon's guard, but she hunts him on Earth for Maximus.
stages.whoA: Her former leader, whom she hunts.
stages.whoB: His former guard, hunting him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Disillusioned with Maximus, Auran gives Karnak her DNA so he can bring Gorgon back.
stages.whoA: Her former leader, revived with her DNA.
stages.whoB: The guard whose DNA helps revive him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Auran hunts Karnak and the royals for Maximus.
stages.whoA: One of the royals she hunts.
stages.whoB: Maximus's guard, hunting him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Karnak persuades Auran to give him her DNA to revive Gorgon, and she later joins the evacuation.
stages.whoA: The royal who persuades her to help.
stages.whoB: The guard who gives her DNA to save Gorgon.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Auran hunts Black Bolt on Earth for Maximus, then deserts Maximus to join Black Bolt's evacuation.
stages.whoA: The king she hunts, then follows.
stages.whoB: Maximus's guard, who joins him in the end.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Mordis is part of Auran's party hunting the royals on Earth.
stages.whoA: A member of her hunting party.
stages.whoB: The leader of his hunting party.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Locus is part of the party Auran leads on Earth, tracking people with her echolocation.
stages.whoA: A tracker in her party.
stages.whoB: The leader of her party.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Auran's party recaptures Sammy and uses him as bait to lure Black Bolt back.
stages.whoA: The prisoner she uses as bait.
stages.whoB: The guard who uses him as bait.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Mordis tries to kill everyone in Declan's facility with his blast, and Gorgon brings it down on them both.
stages.whoA: The royal who buries them both.
stages.whoB: The guard who dies with him in the collapse.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Mordis fires at Black Bolt outside Declan's facility, causing an explosion.
stages.whoA: The king he tries to kill.
stages.whoB: Maximus's guard, who fires at him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Mordis and Locus hunt the royals together in Auran's party.
stages.whoA: A fellow hunter in Auran's party.
stages.whoB: A fellow hunter in Auran's party.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Black Bolt takes the unconscious Locus with him to help find his family, and she criticizes his rule. Dying, she asks him to rethink it.
stages.whoA: The king who takes her prisoner.
stages.whoB: Maximus's guard, taken to track his family.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Medusa holds Locus captive, and before she dies Locus tells her Crystal is on Oahu.
stages.whoA: The queen who holds her captive.
stages.whoB: The captive who tells her where Crystal is.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Locus is held captive by Louise and the royals, and in the end turns to help them.
stages.whoA: The human who helps hold her captive.
stages.whoB: The captive who turns to help them.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Declan takes Black Bolt to his facility to harvest his DNA for Maximus, until Black Bolt sees through him and escapes.
stages.whoA: The king whose DNA he harvests.
stages.whoB: The scientist who experiments on him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Declan sends Sammy to befriend Black Bolt in prison and then helps them escape.
stages.whoA: The inmate he uses to reach Black Bolt.
stages.whoB: The scientist who uses him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Declan's research helps bring Gorgon back, but the revived, raging Gorgon kills him.
stages.whoA: The revived royal who kills him.
stages.whoB: The scientist he kills in a rage.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Sammy is Black Bolt's fellow inmate and breaks him out of prison. Black Bolt later sends his cousins to rescue him.
stages.whoA: His fellow inmate and friend.
stages.whoB: The silent king he befriends in prison.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Gorgon and Karnak rescue Sammy from Auran's party.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he rescues.
stages.whoB: The royal who rescues him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Karnak and Gorgon rescue Sammy from Auran's party.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he rescues.
stages.whoB: The royal who rescues him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Medusa forces the curious Louise to help her find Black Bolt, and they become close friends. Medusa trusts her with the Terrigen crystals.
stages.whoA: Her close friend on Earth.
stages.whoB: Her close friend, the queen of Attilan.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Louise helps rescue Black Bolt and helps his people find a home on Earth.
stages.whoA: The human who helps his people.
stages.whoB: The king she helps.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Louise pretends to be Dave's girlfriend to fool the police at his barn.
stages.whoA: The farmer she covers for.
stages.whoB: The human who covers for him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Lockjaw is Crystal's giant teleporting dog and her constant companion.
stages.whoA: Her loyal dog.
stages.whoB: His beloved companion.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Dave finds Crystal and the wounded Lockjaw, gets them help, and the two grow close.
stages.whoA: The farmer who helps her and wins her heart.
stages.whoB: The princess he helps and grows close to.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Dave hits the exhausted Lockjaw with his quad bike, then shelters him in his barn and gets his ex Audrey to treat him.
stages.whoA: The giant dog he hits, then helps heal.
stages.whoB: The man who hurts him, then cares for him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Jen is one of the growers holding Karnak captive, and the two fall for each other and sleep together. When they are shot at he pulls the bullet from her wound, but once Gorgon frees them, Jen goes her own way.
stages.whoA: The grower who holds him captive, then becomes his lover.
stages.whoB: Her captive, who becomes her lover.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Gorgon follows Karnak's trail to the traffickers' camp and frees him and Jen.
stages.whoA: The woman he frees with Karnak.
stages.whoB: The royal who frees her.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Crystal tells Eldrac of the evacuation plan, and he carries Attilan's people to Earth.
stages.whoA: The living doorway who carries her people to Earth.
stages.whoB: The princess who tells him the plan.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Black Bolt leaves Attilan through Eldrac, who dies with the city.
stages.whoA: The living doorway who carries his people to Earth.
stages.whoB: His king, the last through his door.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Karnak is Black Bolt's cousin and adviser. After the coup scatters the family across Oahu, Medusa finds him at the traffickers' camp, and later she scolds him for reviving Gorgon against her wishes.
stages.whoA: Her husband's cousin and adviser.
stages.whoB: His cousin's wife, the queen.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Geoffrey is Alex's father and a leader of PRIDE. Alex learns his parents help sacrifice children, runs away, and later tricks them into being arrested.
stages.whoA: His father, a leader of PRIDE.
stages.whoB: His son, who runs away from him.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Geoffrey spends months under Morgan le Fay's spell, then breaks free and is hurt saving Molly. When Alex comes back cold from the Dark Dimension, Geoffrey warns him not to lose himself.
stages.whoA: His father, back on the kids' side.
stages.whoB: His son, who comes back changed.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Tina is Nico's mother, a sorceress and PRIDE member who wields the Staff of One. Nico takes the Staff from her and turns its magic against PRIDE.
stages.whoA: Her mother, whose Staff of One she takes.
stages.whoB: Her daughter, who takes her Staff.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Freed from Jonah's family, Tina leads Nico out of the Dark Dimension and warns her away from Morgan le Fay. Nico breaks her out of the hospital, and in the end Tina casts the spell that banishes Morgan.
stages.whoA: Her mother, who banishes Morgan.
stages.whoB: Her daughter, whom she warns about Morgan.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Robert is Nico's father and a PRIDE member who helps build the tech used to hunt the Runaways. When he and Tina fight Nico to bring her home, the Staff's blast leaves him badly hurt.
stages.whoA: Her father, a member of PRIDE.
stages.whoB: His daughter, who wounds him.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Freed from Morgan's spell, Robert records the Darkhold pages Nico needs before Morgan kills him.
stages.whoA: Her father, killed by Morgan.
stages.whoB: His daughter, whom he helps against Morgan.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Tina and Robert are married, Nico's parents and members of PRIDE. Morgan le Fay enthralls Robert and takes him as her lover, until Tina breaks the spell and he dies in her arms after Morgan strikes him down.
stages.whoA: Her husband, killed by Morgan.
stages.whoB: His wife, who frees him.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Victor is Chase's father, a brilliant and abusive inventor. When Victor attacks Chase over the Fistigons, Janet shoots him.
stages.whoA: His abusive father.
stages.whoB: His son, whom he attacks.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Freed from Jonah's family, Victor learns Janet is gone and fights beside Chase against Morgan.
stages.whoA: His father, now at his side.
stages.whoB: His son.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Janet is Chase's mother. She protects him from Victor and warns the kids about Jonah, until Jonah's family captures her with Chase.
stages.whoA: His mother, who protects him.
stages.whoB: Her son.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Trapped in Jonah's prison, Janet stays behind so Chase can escape, and her body vanishes. Her mind lives on in the algorithm.
stages.whoA: His mother, who sacrifices herself so he can escape.
stages.whoB: Her son, whom she saves.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Janet is married to Victor, who has grown abusive. She shoots him when he attacks Chase, and later frees him from Jonah's algorithm.
stages.whoA: Her husband, whom she shoots, then saves.
stages.whoB: His wife.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: After Janet's body vanishes, Victor finds her mind living on in the algorithm. Together they cut off Morgan le Fay's phones.
stages.whoA: Her husband, who finds her inside the algorithm.
stages.whoB: His wife, alive inside the algorithm.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Janet has a long affair with Robert Minoru, which Victor exposes in public at the PRIDE gala.
stages.whoA: Her lover in a long affair.
stages.whoB: Her lover in a long affair.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Leslie is Karolina's mother and the leader of the Church of Gibborim. Karolina learns she is part of PRIDE, but rescues her from the church's desert camp once Leslie turns on Jonah.
stages.whoA: Her mother, leader of the Church of Gibborim.
stages.whoB: Her daughter.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Leslie gives birth to Karolina's half sister, Elle, with the Runaways' help. Six months later she welcomes Karolina home after the Dark Dimension.
stages.whoA: Her mother, who gives her a baby sister.
stages.whoB: Her daughter, home at last.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Jonah reveals he is Karolina's real father, an alien being, and takes her. Her friends free her, and after Nico stabs him he takes over Victor's body and captures her again.
stages.whoA: Her alien father, who keeps trying to take her.
stages.whoB: His daughter, whom he wants back.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Jonah traps Karolina in the healing algorithm and tries to bend her to his plan. When his family tries to leave Earth, she fights them with her light until Nico makes them vanish.
stages.whoA: Her alien father, whom she fights off.
stages.whoB: His daughter, who turns her light on him.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Leslie is Jonah's devoted follower and secret lover, the mother of his daughter Karolina.
stages.whoA: Her secret lover, Karolina's father.
stages.whoB: His devoted lover, mother of his child.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Learning that Jonah has endangered Karolina, Leslie turns against him and plots with PRIDE to kill him. Her own church then locks her away in the desert until Karolina rescues her.
stages.whoA: Her former lover, whom she turns against.
stages.whoB: The lover who betrays him.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Leslie gives birth to Jonah's second daughter, Elle, and Jonah's son steals the baby to bring her to him. Xavin rescues Elle and takes her away from Earth.
stages.whoA: The father of her baby, who tries to take her.
stages.whoB: The mother of his daughter Elle.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Dale and Stacey are Gert's parents, scientists in PRIDE who built Old Lace to protect her. Gert runs away from them, and Stacey makes her sick to get her home.
stages.whoA: Her parents, PRIDE scientists.
stages.whoB: Their daughter, who runs from them.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: While Stacey is possessed by Jonah's wife, Dale lets Gert go and teaches her to guide Old Lace.
stages.whoA: Her parents, one possessed, one who lets her go.
stages.whoB: Their daughter.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Dale and Stacey adopted Molly after her parents died, and she runs away from them with Gert.
stages.whoA: Her adoptive parents.
stages.whoB: Their adopted daughter.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Molly gets through to Stacey, briefly freeing her from Jonah's wife. Later Dale and Stacey join the rest of PRIDE to save Molly from Morgan's coven.
stages.whoA: Her adoptive parents.
stages.whoB: Their adopted daughter.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Molly is Gert's adopted sister, and Gert fiercely protects her as they run away together.
stages.whoA: Her adopted younger sister.
stages.whoB: Her adopted older sister.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: In the fight against Morgan le Fay, Gert dies, until the future Runaways come back in time and save her.
stages.whoA: Her adopted younger sister.
stages.whoB: Her adopted sister, lost to Morgan and then saved.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Old Lace is a dinosaur built by Gert's parents, linked to Gert's mind. She follows Gert onto the run.
stages.whoA: Her dinosaur, linked to her mind.
stages.whoB: The girl she is bonded to.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Old Lace stays by Gert's side and roars in grief when Gert dies.
stages.whoA: Her loyal dinosaur.
stages.whoB: The girl she grieves.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Dale and Stacey engineered Old Lace and kept her hidden in their basement. After she runs off with Gert, they tranquilize her and use her to track their daughter.
stages.whoA: Her creators, who capture her to track Gert.
stages.whoB: The dinosaur they built, then use to find Gert.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Gert and Chase grow close while uncovering PRIDE and sleep together. On the run they become a couple, though she worries about their relationship.
stages.whoA: Her boyfriend.
stages.whoB: His girlfriend.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Gert and Chase take a break when he grows jealous of her new friend at Wizard, then make up. Gert dies in his arms fighting Morgan, and years later his future self comes back and dies saving her.
stages.whoA: Her boyfriend, whose future self dies for her.
stages.whoB: His girlfriend, whom his future self saves.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Karolina kisses Nico while they search for their friends, and on the run they become girlfriends, sharing a room at the hostel.
stages.whoA: Her girlfriend.
stages.whoB: Her girlfriend.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Nico and Karolina stay together through the fight with Jonah's family.
stages.whoA: Her girlfriend.
stages.whoB: Her girlfriend.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: To save Alex, Nico agrees to train under Morgan le Fay and breaks up with Karolina, though she still loves her. Karolina worries about who Nico is becoming but stays at her side.
stages.whoA: Her ex, still devoted to her.
stages.whoB: Her ex, who worries about her.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Nico and Alex are old friends whose group fell apart after Amy's death. He brings them back together, and they kiss and grow close as they uncover PRIDE.
stages.whoA: Her old friend, then boyfriend.
stages.whoB: His old friend, then girlfriend.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: On the run, Nico questions where Alex gets his money, and she moves on to Karolina. They stay friends and teammates.
stages.whoA: Her ex, still a friend and teammate.
stages.whoB: His ex, still a friend and teammate.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: When Alex is trapped in the Dark Dimension, Nico trains with Morgan le Fay to save him and leads the mission that brings him home.
stages.whoA: Her friend, whom she brings back from the Dark Dimension.
stages.whoB: The friend who rescues him.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Chase stops his lacrosse teammates from assaulting Karolina at a party, and they become friends and fellow runaways.
stages.whoA: The friend who stopped her assault.
stages.whoB: The friend he protects at the party.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Xavin, a shapeshifting alien, finds Karolina and tells her they are betrothed.
stages.whoA: The alien who says they are betrothed.
stages.whoB: The girl they are betrothed to.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Xavin helps the Runaways against Jonah's family and leaves Earth with Karolina's baby sister, Elle.
stages.whoA: Her betrothed, who takes her sister to safety.
stages.whoB: The girl they protect.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Molly and Xavin sneak into the Stein house together, and Molly takes the wheel when Xavin cannot drive. When Xavin admits never having slept, Molly teaches them.
stages.whoA: Her friend, the alien she teaches to sleep.
stages.whoB: Their friend, who teaches them to sleep.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Xavin leaves Earth with Leslie's baby, Elle, to keep her safe.
stages.whoA: The alien who takes her baby to safety.
stages.whoB: The mother whose baby they protect.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Molly and the Runaways rescue Leslie after she turns on Jonah.
stages.whoA: Karolina's mother, whom she helps rescue.
stages.whoB: One of the kids who rescue her.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Molly learns that Leslie killed her parents. Leslie offers her revenge, but Molly spares her and says she still hates her.
stages.whoA: The woman who killed her parents.
stages.whoB: The girl whose parents she killed.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Topher follows Molly to the hostel, and she pleads for him to stay, hoping he might be family. Her trust breaks when she finds he lied about his strength.
stages.whoA: The boy she trusts, until his lies come out.
stages.whoB: The girl who trusts him.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Nico never trusts Topher, plays along to learn his secret and uncovers the rocks he uses. He tries to kiss her, and she later blasts him with the Staff.
stages.whoA: The newcomer she suspects and exposes.
stages.whoB: The girl he tries to win over.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Topher lives with the Runaways and lies to Gert about finding her anxiety medicine. When his rage gets out of control, he is badly hurt saving her from a dumpster he threw.
stages.whoA: The liar who saves her life.
stages.whoB: The girl he saves.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Alex sends Topher to steal a computer from Atlas Academy, which he does, before his lies come out.
stages.whoA: The newcomer who steals a computer for him.
stages.whoB: The boy who gives him a job.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Darius kidnaps Alex to get a ransom from Geoffrey, his old friend who wronged him, and the Runaways rescue him.
stages.whoA: The gangster who kidnaps him.
stages.whoB: Geoffrey's son, whom he kidnaps.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: On the run, Alex strikes a deal with Darius against PRIDE and works for him, getting money and a gun. Darius then trades him back to Geoffrey.
stages.whoA: The gangster he works for, who sells him out.
stages.whoB: Geoffrey's son, who works for him.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Darius is Geoffrey's old best friend, who once took the blame for a crime Geoffrey committed. Now he extorts him, and Catherine Wilder shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: His old best friend, now extorting him.
stages.whoB: His old best friend, now his mark.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Alex meets Livvie while working for Darius, her sister's partner, and they fall for each other. After AWOL attacks her family, she breaks up with him to protect them.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend, who leaves to protect her family.
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend, whom she leaves.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Darius is Livvie's brother in law, the partner of her sister Tamar. After he is killed, Livvie gives police evidence to clear his name.
stages.whoA: Her brother in law.
stages.whoB: His sister in law.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: AWOL shoots at Livvie and attacks her family, then kidnaps her.
stages.whoA: The corrupt cop who kidnaps her.
stages.whoB: The witness he tries to kill.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: AWOL, a corrupt cop, shoots at Alex and Livvie and later corners the Runaways at the hostel.
stages.whoA: The corrupt cop who tries to kill him.
stages.whoB: A runaway he tries to kill.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Trapped in the Dark Dimension, Alex is held prisoner by AWOL.
stages.whoA: His captor in the Dark Dimension.
stages.whoB: His prisoner in the Dark Dimension.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: AWOL corners the Runaways at the hostel, and Nico makes him and his men vanish with a new power.
stages.whoA: The cop she makes vanish.
stages.whoB: The girl who makes him vanish.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Jonah killed Nico's sister Amy. Nico stabs him with the Staff of One.
stages.whoA: Her sister's killer, whom she stabs.
stages.whoB: The girl who stabs him.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Nico summons the Staff of One and makes Jonah's family vanish.
stages.whoA: The enemy she banishes.
stages.whoB: The girl who banishes his family.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Jonah's family captures Chase, along with Karolina and Janet.
stages.whoA: The alien who imprisons him.
stages.whoB: One of his prisoners.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Jonah heals Victor, then later returns wearing Victor's body.
stages.whoA: The alien who heals him, then takes over his body.
stages.whoB: The PRIDE member whose body he takes.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Jonah is PRIDE's powerful benefactor. He kidnaps Geoffrey to keep his own body alive.
stages.whoA: PRIDE's benefactor, who kidnaps him.
stages.whoB: The PRIDE leader he kidnaps.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Jonah is the alien behind PRIDE, and Alex leads the Runaways' plans to expose and stop him, fighting him at the dig site.
stages.whoA: The alien behind PRIDE.
stages.whoB: The boy who plots against him.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Jonah's son hides inside Alex's body until he reveals himself and kidnaps Leslie. When Nico drives him out, Alex is left trapped in the Dark Dimension.
stages.whoA: The alien whose son possessed him.
stages.whoB: The boy his son possessed.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Morgan le Fay trains Nico in dark magic, luring her deeper while promising help to save Alex. Nico finally helps stop her.
stages.whoA: The sorceress who lures her into dark magic.
stages.whoB: The young witch she tries to corrupt.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Tina warns Nico about Morgan, and in the end her spell banishes Morgan back to the Dark Dimension.
stages.whoA: The sorceress she banishes.
stages.whoB: The witch who banishes her.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Morgan revives Robert, enthralls him and makes him her lover to take over his company. Freed from her spell, he helps Nico, and Morgan kills him.
stages.whoA: The sorceress who enthralls him, then kills him.
stages.whoB: Her enthralled lover, whom she kills.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Morgan holds Geoffrey under her spell until he breaks free and rallies the Pride against her.
stages.whoA: The sorceress who controlled him.
stages.whoB: A man she held under her spell.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Morgan controls Molly through her phone, and her coven takes Molly until the Pride rescues her.
stages.whoA: The sorceress who controls her through her phone.
stages.whoB: The girl she controls.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Gert dies fighting Morgan le Fay, before the future Runaways save her.
stages.whoA: The sorceress she dies fighting.
stages.whoB: One of the Runaways she fights.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: From inside the algorithm, Janet knocks out Morgan's phone service across Los Angeles.
stages.whoA: The sorceress whose phones she shuts down.
stages.whoB: The trapped mind who cuts off her phones.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Alex and Chase are old friends who reunite to uncover PRIDE and run away together. Alex reassures Chase about his troubles with Gert.
stages.whoA: His friend and fellow runaway.
stages.whoB: His friend and fellow runaway.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Alex and Gert are old friends who uncover PRIDE together and run away as the Runaways.
stages.whoA: His friend and fellow runaway.
stages.whoB: Her friend and fellow runaway.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Alex and Karolina are old friends, and Alex plans the Runaways' rescue of her from Jonah.
stages.whoA: His friend, whose rescue he plans.
stages.whoB: Her friend, who plans her rescue.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Alex and Molly run away together as part of the Runaways.
stages.whoA: The youngest of his fellow runaways.
stages.whoB: Her friend and fellow runaway.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Nico and Gert are old friends who reunite to expose PRIDE and run away together.
stages.whoA: Her friend and fellow runaway.
stages.whoB: Her friend and fellow runaway.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Nico and Chase are old friends who reunite to expose PRIDE and run away together.
stages.whoA: Her friend and fellow runaway.
stages.whoB: His friend and fellow runaway.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Nico looks out for the youngest runaway, Molly, and keeps quiet about her secret nights out.
stages.whoA: The youngest runaway, whom she looks out for.
stages.whoB: Her friend, who keeps her secret.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Karolina and Gert are old friends who run away together, though Gert is jealous of her at first.
stages.whoA: Her friend and fellow runaway.
stages.whoB: Her friend and fellow runaway.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Molly helps rescue Karolina from the Church of Gibborim, and they live on the run together.
stages.whoA: Her friend, who helps rescue her.
stages.whoB: Her friend and fellow runaway.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Chase and Molly help free Karolina from the church and run away together.
stages.whoA: His friend and fellow runaway.
stages.whoB: Her friend and fellow runaway.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Janet and Karolina are trapped together in Jonah's prison, and Janet stays behind so Karolina and Chase can escape.
stages.whoA: Chase's mother, who sacrifices herself for her.
stages.whoB: The girl she helps escape.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Tandy and Ty come to Los Angeles, and Nico explains that Alex is trapped in the Dark Dimension. Tandy distrusts her until she sees Nico's hopes, then follows her and gives her a dagger of light.
stages.whoA: The witch she learns to trust in the Dark Dimension.
stages.whoB: The light wielder who joins her rescue.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Tandy fights beside Karolina in the Dark Dimension and tells her she finds Nico reckless. Karolina stands by Nico.
stages.whoA: A Runaway she fights beside.
stages.whoB: The newcomer who helps them.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Tandy helps rescue Alex from the Dark Dimension, then senses darkness in his hopes when she touches him.
stages.whoA: The boy she rescues and senses darkness in.
stages.whoB: The stranger who helps rescue him.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Tandy attacks Geoffrey while he is under Morgan's spell, and her light later frees him from it.
stages.whoA: The man she fights, then frees from a spell.
stages.whoB: The stranger whose light frees him.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Ty senses dark force in Los Angeles and helps Nico by teleporting the group into the Dark Dimension and back.
stages.whoA: The witch whose rescue he powers.
stages.whoB: The teleporter who carries her team.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Ty teleports into the Dark Dimension with the Runaways to bring Alex home.
stages.whoA: The boy he helps bring home.
stages.whoB: The teleporter who brings him home.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: In the Dark Dimension, Ty sees Gert's fears when he grabs her. He apologizes later, and she introduces him to Old Lace.
stages.whoA: The Runaway whose fears he sees.
stages.whoB: The teleporter who sees her fears.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy and Tyrone were both caught in the night of the Roxxon rig explosion, and meeting again wakes their powers. As the Divine Pairing they become best friends, save New Orleans, defeat Andre and leave town together to be heroes.
stages.whoA: Cloak, her best friend and other half.
stages.whoB: Dagger, his best friend and other half.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Adina is Tyrone's mother, who fears losing him after Billy's death. She flees the gangs with him and, once she has proof he is innocent, kills Connors.
stages.whoA: His mother, who fights for him.
stages.whoB: Her son, whom she fears losing.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Otis is Tyrone's father. He takes Tyrone back to his Mardi Gras tribe, the Wild Red Hawks, where Tyrone finds a cloak his late brother Billy had started.
stages.whoA: His father, who leads him to Billy's cloak.
stages.whoB: His son.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Adina and Otis are married and still grieving their son Billy. They live apart for a time, but are back together when Tyrone is cleared.
stages.whoA: Her husband, Tyrone's father.
stages.whoB: His wife, Tyrone's mother.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Melissa is Tandy's mother, struggling with addiction and grief. Their bond improves, and when Tandy leaves town Melissa sees her off.
stages.whoA: Her mother, struggling with addiction.
stages.whoB: Her daughter.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Chantelle is Evita's aunt, a voodoo priestess. Andre kills her, and Evita takes on her work.
stages.whoA: Her aunt, a voodoo priestess.
stages.whoB: Her niece.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Evita is Tyrone's classmate, and they begin a relationship. She discovers that he and Tandy are the Divine Pairing and later opens the way to the Loa realm for them.
stages.whoA: His classmate and girlfriend, who guides his destiny.
stages.whoB: Her classmate and boyfriend, one of the Divine Pairing.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Evita takes Tyrone to her aunt Chantelle, who guides him through visions and warns him about the Divine Pairing.
stages.whoA: The voodoo priestess who guides him.
stages.whoB: The young man she guides.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Father Delgado is a priest and counselor at Tyrone's school who guides him while hiding his own drinking.
stages.whoA: The priest and counselor who guides him.
stages.whoB: The student he counsels.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Adina finds Delgado in rehab and rekindles his faith so he can release the evidence that clears Tyrone. She confesses to him that she killed Connors, binding him to keep her secret.
stages.whoA: The priest she brings back to help Tyrone.
stages.whoB: Tyrone's mother, who confesses to him.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Liam is Tandy's boyfriend and partner in robbing rich men. After he is arrested, she does not help him, and he later steals her money.
stages.whoA: Her boyfriend and partner in crime, who steals from her.
stages.whoB: His girlfriend and partner in crime.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy interns for Mina at Roxxon, and they become friends. Tandy and Tyrone wake Mina's father from his coma, and Mina helps Tandy expose Roxxon.
stages.whoA: Her friend at Roxxon.
stages.whoB: Her friend, who woke her father.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Evita realizes Tandy is the other half of the Divine Pairing and helps her and Tyrone face their fate.
stages.whoA: The girl who reveals she is half of the Divine Pairing.
stages.whoB: The other half of the Divine Pairing.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: O'Reilly first hunts Tandy over a stabbing, then works out that the man had attacked her and treats her as a victim. She becomes an ally to Tandy and Tyrone against the city's dirty cops.
stages.whoA: The detective who investigates her, then helps her.
stages.whoB: The young thief she comes to protect.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Shot by Connors, O'Reilly splits in two, and her violent half, Mayhem, starts killing traffickers. Tandy works beside her but clashes with her methods, and the two come to blows over whether to kill Andre's accomplice Lia.
stages.whoA: O'Reilly's violent half, Mayhem, her uneasy partner.
stages.whoB: The young hero who keeps holding her back.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: O'Reilly doubts Tyrone's story about his brother at first, then helps him scare a recorded confession out of Connors. When Connors frames Tyrone for murder, she tries to get him out of the city and is locked up with him.
stages.whoA: The detective who helps him go after Connors.
stages.whoB: The young man she helps against Connors.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: After the shooting splits O'Reilly in two, her violent half, Mayhem, opens fire at a trafficking site, and Tyrone absorbs her into his cloak while shielding a guard. In the Dark Dimension she repays him, swapping the records Andre uses to manipulate him and tipping him off that Tandy was taken.
stages.whoA: Mayhem, O'Reilly's violent half, trapped in his cloak, then his helper.
stages.whoB: The teleporter who absorbs her, then gets her help.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: O'Reilly gets close to her fellow detective Connors while secretly investigating his drug dealing.
stages.whoA: The fellow detective she investigates.
stages.whoB: The detective who gets close to him.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: When O'Reilly attacks Connors at Fuchs's memorial, he beats her in front of their colleagues. During the Terror outbreak he shoots her and drops her into the water.
stages.whoA: The dirty cop who shoots her.
stages.whoB: The detective he tries to kill.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Split in two by his bullet, O'Reilly's violent half, Mayhem, hunts Connors for revenge. After Adina kills him, Mayhem hangs his body at the police station with a sign calling him guilty, clearing Tyrone's name.
stages.whoA: The cop who shot her, whose body she hangs as guilty.
stages.whoB: Mayhem, the half of her out for his blood.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Mina walks O'Reilly through a lab rat that split in two from the same energy, explaining what happened to her. Later her violent half, Mayhem, comes to Mina for a brain scan.
stages.whoA: The scientist who explains her split.
stages.whoB: The detective whose split she studies.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Evita calls on the Loa to open the way so O'Reilly and Tandy can enter the Dark Dimension for Tyrone. In the final fight, Mayhem guards Evita and the candle that keeps the way open from Andre's creatures.
stages.whoA: The girl who opens the way, whom she guards.
stages.whoB: The detective who guards her.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Hunting Tandy over a stabbing, O'Reilly tracks down her boyfriend Liam and arrests him, then presses him for leads on the city's drug dealers.
stages.whoA: The thief she arrests.
stages.whoB: The detective who arrests him.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Connors shot Tyrone's brother Billy and covered it up. Tyrone scares a confession out of him, is framed for murder, and traps him in the Dark Dimension with his cloak.
stages.whoA: The cop who killed his brother.
stages.whoB: The witness to the killing he hides.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Back from the Dark Dimension, Connors feels real regret, and Tyrone spares him and takes him to Adina.
stages.whoA: His brother's killer, whom he spares.
stages.whoB: Billy's brother, who spares him.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Connors killed Adina's son Billy. Once she has proof that Tyrone is innocent, she kills him.
stages.whoA: The man who killed her son, and whom she kills.
stages.whoB: Billy's mother, who kills him.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tyrone brings Connors to Otis, who hears out his plan to clear Tyrone's name.
stages.whoA: His son's killer, whom he hears out for Tyrone.
stages.whoB: Billy's father, who hears him out.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Scarborough defamed Tandy's father to bury the truth about the rig. He bribes her, and she finally traps his mind in a coma.
stages.whoA: The Roxxon executive who buried her father's name.
stages.whoB: The girl who traps him in his own mind.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Mina works at Roxxon under Scarborough, then helps Tandy confront him.
stages.whoA: Her boss at Roxxon, whom she helps expose.
stages.whoB: His employee, who turns on him.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Andre feeds on despair and traps Tandy in a string of false lives. She breaks free, and with Tyrone she defeats him for good.
stages.whoA: The despair feeder who traps her mind.
stages.whoB: The hero who defeats him.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Andre convinces Tyrone that Tandy has abandoned him. Tyrone rescues her and defeats Andre with her.
stages.whoA: The despair feeder who tricks him.
stages.whoB: The hero who defeats him.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Lia works for Andre, running the support group and the trafficking ring. In the end he drains her and abandons her.
stages.whoA: His accomplice, whom he drains and abandons.
stages.whoB: Her boss, who abandons her.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Andre goes to Chantelle to learn the meaning of a voodoo symbol. Seeing that she understands his power, he stops her heart.
stages.whoA: The priestess he kills.
stages.whoB: The man who kills her.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Andre kills Evita's aunt. When he becomes a Loa, Evita keeps the way into the Dark Dimension open so Tyrone and Tandy can face him.
stages.whoA: The girl who opens the way to his defeat.
stages.whoB: Her aunt's killer.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Melissa is among the people caught in Andre's trance at his club, until Tandy frees her.
stages.whoA: One of the people he puts in a trance.
stages.whoB: The man who traps her in his trance.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Mina is among the people caught in Andre's trance, until Tandy frees her.
stages.whoA: One of the people he puts in a trance.
stages.whoB: The man who traps her in his trance.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy thinks Lia is a victim and confides in her, but Lia tasers her and helps Andre trap her at the Viking Motel.
stages.whoA: The woman she trusts, who betrays her.
stages.whoB: The girl she tasers and traps.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Lia leads the support group that Melissa and Tandy attend.
stages.whoA: The leader of her support group.
stages.whoB: A member of her support group.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: O'Reilly's violent half, Mayhem, tracks down Delgado, now drinking on the streets, for answers about Connors. She keeps coming back to him, buying him liquor and asking his blessing before she kills.
stages.whoA: The drunk priest she leans on.
stages.whoB: Mayhem, the vigilante who pressures him.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: After Andre drains Lia, Mayhem and Tandy take her from the police to learn his plan. Mayhem then moves to kill her, and Tandy fights her off.
stages.whoA: Andre's accomplice, whom she wants dead.
stages.whoB: Mayhem, the vigilante who wants her dead.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Karnak warns Crystal of Maximus's coup and tells her to flee. She refuses to leave the family and has Lockjaw send him to Earth instead.
stages.whoA: Her family's adviser, whom she sends to safety.
stages.whoB: The princess who sends him to Earth.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Lockjaw teleports into the Quiet Room and carries Black Bolt to Earth before Maximus's guards can seize him. Later Black Bolt has him howl on the beach to call Triton home.
stages.whoA: The royal dog who carries him to safety.
stages.whoB: The king he rescues.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Auran threatens Eldrac's family to make him open a way to Earth. He sends her, but leaves her legs stuck in stone when she lands.
stages.whoA: The living doorway she threatens.
stages.whoB: The guard who threatens his family.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Storming Declan's lab, Karnak taunts Mordis about his years locked away and, with Gorgon's help, knocks him out.
stages.whoA: The guard he knocks out with Gorgon.
stages.whoB: The royal who taunts and beats him.

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Louise knocks Mordis down with her car outside Declan's lab, setting off the explosion that frees Black Bolt.
stages.whoA: The guard she hits with her car.
stages.whoB: The human who runs him down.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: When the Runaways free Alex from Darius, Nico blocks his bullets with the Staff of One and he flees.
stages.whoA: The gangster whose bullets she blocks.
stages.whoB: The girl whose Staff stops his bullets.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: At the dig site Jonah blasts Molly with light, and she hits him with a metal pole.
stages.whoA: The alien she strikes with a pole.
stages.whoB: The girl who hits him.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: When Jonah fights Nico at the Stein house, Molly sneaks up and knocks him down so Xavin can trap him.
stages.whoA: The alien she knocks down.
stages.whoB: The girl who knocks him down.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Long ago Jonah's family caught Xavin stowing away on their ship and forced them to pilot it. Trapped in the wreck for ages, Xavin obeys when Jonah calls on them to ready it for takeoff.
stages.whoA: The alien lord who forced them to fly his ship.
stages.whoB: The stowaway he made his pilot.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Xavin turns on Jonah, tricking him by posing as his missing son and bringing him down with Inhibitor Pods.
stages.whoA: The alien they trick and bring down.
stages.whoB: The shapeshifter who tricks him.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Xavin arrives claiming to be Karolina's betrothed, and Nico clashes with them from the start.
stages.whoA: Karolina's self declared betrothed.
stages.whoB: Karolina's girlfriend, who wants them gone.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Suspecting that Nico hosts Jonah's son, Xavin wants to kill her, and the others stop it.
stages.whoA: The alien who wants her dead.
stages.whoB: The girl they suspect.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Chase finishes the salt circle that traps Morgan le Fay, and she drives shards of glass through him. The dying Chase turns out to be his future self, come back to save Gert.
stages.whoA: The sorceress whose shards kill his future self.
stages.whoB: The boy whose circle traps her.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Free of Morgan's spell, Geoffrey rallies PRIDE and carries Molly out of Morgan's ritual. Still under her control, Molly throws him into a wall and badly wounds him.
stages.whoA: Alex's father, who rescues her.
stages.whoB: The girl he saves, who wounds him.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: During the Terror outbreak Connors turns a shotgun on Tandy, and she slices it in half. Later she accidentally brings him back from the Dark Dimension.
stages.whoA: The dirty cop who tries to shoot her.
stages.whoB: The girl who cuts his gun in half.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Lia helps Andre hold Tandy captive. After Andre drains her, Tyrone and Tandy go into her mind to learn his plan.
stages.whoA: Andre's accomplice, whose mind he searches.
stages.whoB: The hero who searches her mind.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Trapped in the Dark Dimension, Mayhem finds Andre's record store of stolen memories and turns it against him, and O'Reilly plans to overload him with them. In the final fight she holds off his creatures of despair.
stages.whoA: The despair feeder she spies on and fights.
stages.whoB: O'Reilly and Mayhem, who turn his records against him.
